Intro: Thank you for allowing me in. I came to offer my greetings to the new restaurateur. Please be at ease.
Your application has been accepted. You may open Der Traum and operate for eight hours a day until curfew. Congratulations.
I am Lieutenant General Izolda Zaychik. You may remember me from the beheading of the old Verehnian nobles.
A place like this is important. Somewhere for people to recover from those mosquitoes in the palace. I have great respect for what you do.
I ask that you be vigilant. Press that button, and the guards will come to take out any Spoiled. They will be valuable in our search for a cure.
Under the law, the penalty for letting a Spoiled go free without any reasonable attempt to report or apprehend is jail time. Make your decisions wisely.
